prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1346; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not say my full name on the recording, if that's okay. You can refer to me as the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving through League City, Texas, on a weekday afternoon. I was turning left at an intersection with a traffic light.

Q: What was the signal showing when you began your turn?

A: It was a green light, but the left-turn arrow had already ended, so I was turning on the solid green. I checked for oncoming cars and started to go.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming straight through the intersection hit the driver's side of my car. It came in fast, and I felt a hard jolt that threw me against the seatbelt and then back into the seat.

Q: Did you lose consciousness or hit your head?

A: No, I didn't black out and I don't think I hit my head on anything. My neck snapped forward and back, though, and my lower back has been sore ever since.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and a back strain, and I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've had trouble sleeping and I'm missing some work because sitting for long periods makes the pain worse. I'm hoping to get everything resolved as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
